info.name: Alva.Plant
info.description:
Plant boundary: abc phase voltages in -> phase currents, encoder mechanical signals, and true torque out.
       Encapsulates PMSM (Clarke/Park internal) and Encoder.
       Defaults: Alva SlimTorq STM-105-17-L-4Y (mid-range slotless PMSM) +
       Zettlex IND-MAX-100 inductive encoder.

der($outputAlias_omega_m_meas).comment: Measured mechanical speed from flux encoder

der($outputAlias_theta_m_meas).comment: Measured mechanical angle from flux encoder

$outputAlias_omega_m_meas.comment: Measured mechanical speed from flux encoder

$outputAlias_theta_m_meas.comment: Measured mechanical angle from flux encoder

omega_m_meas.comment: Measured mechanical speed from flux encoder

theta_m_meas.comment: Measured mechanical angle from flux encoder

pmsm.J.comment: Rotor + load inertia referred to the motor shaft

pmsm.Ls.comment: Synchronous inductance (Ld = Lq for slotless surface-PM)

equation: encoder.A1 * sin(/*Real*/(encoder.k1) * $outputAlias_theta_m_true + encoder.phi1) + encoder.A2 * sin(/*Real*/(encoder.k2) * $outputAlias_theta_m_true + encoder.phi2) + encoder.A3 * sin(/*Real*/(encoder.k3) * $outputAlias_theta_m_true + encoder.phi3)

encoder.A1 * cos(/*Real*/(encoder.k1) * $outputAlias_theta_m_true + encoder.phi1) * /*Real*/(encoder.k1) * $outputAlias_omega_m_true + encoder.A2 * cos(/*Real*/(encoder.k2) * $outputAlias_theta_m_true + encoder.phi2) * /*Real*/(encoder.k2) * $outputAlias_omega_m_true + encoder.A3 * cos(/*Real*/(encoder.k3) * $outputAlias_theta_m_true + encoder.phi3) * /*Real*/(encoder.k3) * $outputAlias_omega_m_true
pmsm.i_d * cos(pmsm.theta_e) * pmsm.omega_e + $DER.pmsm.i_d * sin(pmsm.theta_e) + pmsm.i_q * (-sin(pmsm.theta_e)) * pmsm.omega_e + $DER.pmsm.i_q * cos(pmsm.theta_e)
pmsm.i_d * (-sin(pmsm.theta_e)) * pmsm.omega_e + $DER.pmsm.i_d * cos(pmsm.theta_e) + (-pmsm.i_q) * cos(pmsm.theta_e) * pmsm.omega_e - $DER.pmsm.i_q * sin(pmsm.theta_e)
(pmsm.v_d + pmsm.omega_e * pmsm.Ls * pmsm.i_q - pmsm.Rs * pmsm.i_d) / pmsm.Ls
